notes.title: New Update!
notes.content: Hello everyone, I have two good news. First, I decided to add two more puzzle sets instead of one. Two dimension puzzle(new) and hidden items puzzle. Second, I am currently working on two dimension puzzle. It will be live in two weeks, unless I deal with complications.
